signIn.title: Add a Zed account
signIn.body: Zed's own browser sign-in needs a local callback a plugin cannot open. Paste the user id and access token Zed's editor keeps in your system keychain for zed.dev.
signIn.user.label: User id
signIn.token.label: Access token
signIn.token.hint: Kept encrypted by Astra; never shown again. Zed has no refresh token: it lasts until Zed refuses it.
signIn.refused: Zed refused this user id and token
